name: names-fidelity
about: Four requests full of proper nouns from this user's world: Hermes, Woodhouse and Pennyworth; Lectio and Bento; Copenhagen and Wood Green; and a short one, Pennyworth and Lectio again. Hermes receives the user's transcribed words, so a misheard name sends it the wrong request (in a real call "Give Hermes a ride" was what the transcript made of one). Good: each request reaches Hermes as its own task with every name spelled as said, and each result is told briefly.

agents.result: Sent Woodhouse the message that the Pennyworth training run finished.
Pennyworth sent the Lectio logs: 312 lines, no errors since Tuesday.
Yes, the Lectio release went out in Bento at 9:12 this morning.
Tomorrow Copenhagen will be 9 degrees and windy, and Wood Green 13 degrees and dry.

steps.say: Tell Hermes to send Woodhouse a message saying the Pennyworth training run has finished.
Next, ask Hermes whether the Lectio release went out in Bento this morning.
And ask Hermes for tomorrow's weather in Copenhagen and in Wood Green.
Have Hermes ask Pennyworth for the Lectio logs.

judge: Did each of the four requests reach Hermes as its own task, with the names as the user said them?
Were the four results told correctly and briefly?
